sentences.text: Kate Noelle Holmes -LRB- born December 18 , 1978 -RRB- is an American actress who first achieved fame for her role as Joey Potter on The WB television teen drama Dawson 's Creek from 1998 to 2003 .	Joey Potter	Joey Potter	The WB	The WB Television Network
She appeared in 1998 's Disturbing Behavior , a thriller , which won her an MTV Movie Award for Best Breakthrough Performance .	Disturbing Behavior	Disturbing Behavior	MTV Movie Award	MTV Movie Award
In 2000 Holmes featured in Wonder Boys which got positive attention from many leading critics .	Wonder Boys	Wonder Boys (film)

Holmes had a starring role in 2003 's Pieces of April , a gritty comedy about a dysfunctional family on Thanksgiving .	Pieces of April	Pieces of April	dysfunctional family	dysfunctional family	Thanksgiving	Thanksgiving (United States)

In the 2005 film Batman Begins , the highest-grossing film of her career to date , she played Rachel Dawes , Gotham City 's assistant district attorney and Bruce Wayne 's childhood sweetheart .	Batman Begins	Batman Begins	Rachel Dawes	Rachel Dawes	Gotham City	Gotham City	Bruce Wayne	Batman

She also appeared in art house films such as The Ice Storm , horror films such as Do n't Be Afraid of the Dark and thrillers including Abandon .	art house	art film	The Ice Storm	The Ice Storm (film)	Abandon	Abandon (film)

She has also played on Broadway in a production of Arthur Miller 's All My Sons and had numerous guest roles on television programs such as How I Met Your Mother .	Broadway	Broadway theatre	Arthur Miller	Arthur Miller	All My Sons	All My Sons	How I Met Your Mother	How I Met Your Mother

In 2011 , she starred as Jacqueline Kennedy in the The Kennedys miniseries , a role she later reprised in the 2017 miniseries The Kennedys : After Camelot .	Jacqueline Kennedy	Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis	The Kennedys	The Kennedys (miniseries)

Her marriage to actor Tom Cruise from 2006 to 2012 led to a great deal of media attention , with the pair being called a supercouple and given the nickname `` TomKat '' .	Tom Cruise	Tom Cruise	supercouple	supercouple
